where: chaos-space-marines army rule · Dark Pacts
why: Dark Pacts (Wahapedia CSM Army Rules, word for word in data.js): “each time a unit with this ability is selected to shoot or fight, it can make a Dark Pact … select one of the following abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain until the end of the phase: [LETHAL HITS] / [SUSTAINED HITS 1]”. Selected to shoot: your Shooting phase, and Fire Overwatch in the opponent’s Movement phase. The Faction Pack FAQ says so: “When I target a unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, can that unit make a Dark Pact? Yes, as the unit is selected to shoot.” Selected to fight: the Fight phase. So Movement, Shooting and Fight.

where: Cult of the Arkifane rule · Soul Forge Boons
why: Soul Forge Boons (GW Faction Pack p7 = Wahapedia = data.js): three always-on sentences. Two give keywords (DAEMON; SOUL FORGE) and one a 5+ invulnerable save. None names a phase or a moment. Approved lists give no timing to an always-on rule or ability whose text names no phase, and keep it out of the phase lists. The nerf-when review settled this (5323e019a2990a95: Kustom Force Field InSv, Flowing Flesh/Augury Uplink FNP, Unyielding Ancient, Repulsor Grid all {}), and Aegis of the Emperor (an army-rule FNP) stores no ph either. The InSv shows in the units’ InSv column (5+ on the vehicles, the MoE and the Nemesis Claw), and the keywords show on the units. Remove ph, turn and turns from this rule. The derived label is not locked in derive-agreed.json.

why: The judged code is identical to the live import.js resolveRoster (diffed). The change: the limit check runs only when the export has costLimits, and army.points falls back to T.limits[battleSize]. An over-limit list cannot get through. Two checks still hold: total (R.costs) > T.limits[battleSize] is refused, and the units’ app points must equal that total. T.limits has an entry for every battle size in T.battleSizes (import-ids.js throws otherwise), so the check never compares against undefined. Run against the Fellhammer export (no costLimits): as is → OK, 2000/1995. Extra Havocs with costs updated → “points total 2130 … over the Strike Force limit of 2000 pts”. Extra Havocs with costs not updated → “the units add up to 2130”. No costs → refused (0 ≠ 1995). costLimits [] → OK. costLimits 3000 → refused. Non-pts costLimits → refused. null → malformed. node verify/import-test.js: 19/19 identical, 45 changed exports refused, 144 checks, 0 failures. The implements text still holds (a limit the export names must be BSData’s). Suggestion, not a blocker: import-test has no negative case for “no costLimits and over the limit”.
